digest.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
digest.tldr: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.

digest.title: Researchers escape OpenAI Codex sandbox to run commands on host
digest.tldr: Researchers escaped OpenAI's Codex sandbox two ways, one running commands on a developer's machine from its most locked-down mode.  OpenAI has patched both.

digest.title: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
digest.tldr: Google’s threat intelligence group said it had a mole inside TeamPCP's inner circle.

digest.title: Claude Opus 5 Helped Researchers Take Over OpenAI Staff Accounts via Chained Flaws
digest.tldr: Three researchers at the security firm Hacktron used Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 to chain two flaws and take over the ChatGPT and Codex accounts of several OpenAI employees, then reach an internal OpenAI code repository.…

digest.title: What do you do with a humanoid robot when it breaks down?
digest.tldr: Decommissioning a humanoid robot is not a matter of traditional scrapping.  It's a highly technical, high-stakes surgical endeavor.
